fullPassage: If we take literally the assumption in the American legal system that one is innocent until proven guilty, then the prior probability of a suspect being guilty is zero, and any evidence, no matter how damning, won't yield a posterior probability above zero, because you'll always be multiplying by zero. A more reasonable way to establish the prior probability of a suspect's innocence is to consider anyone in the population equally likely. Thus, if the suspect was apprehended in a city of 100,000 people, and investigators have reason to believe that the perpetrator was a resident of the city, the prior odds of the suspect being guilty are 1 in 100,000. Of course, evidence can narrow the population — we may know, for example, that there were no signs of forced entry, and so the suspect had to be one of fifty people who had access to the facility.

❌ ② 의미가 뒤바뀜

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a person who commits a crime or does something wrong"

det.korean: perpetrator = 가해자, 범인 (범죄나 잘못을 저지른 사람)
det.analysis:
❌ ① investigator(수사관): 범죄를 조사하는 사람이지 저지른 사람이 아님
❌ ② resident(거주자): 단순히 사는 사람으로 범죄 주체 의미 없음
❌ ③ suspect(용의자): 아직 '의심받는' 단계이지 범죄를 저지른 것이 확정된 주체가 아님
✅ ④ perpetrator(가해자, 범인): 범죄나 잘못을 저지른 사람이라는 정의에 정확히 부합

questions.passage: If we start with a prior probability of zero, then any evidence won't yield a posterior probability above zero, because you'll always be __________ (multiply) by zero. A zero prior wipes out every later calculation.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

multiply → ____

det.korean: 0으로 시작하면 어떤 증거도 0 이상의 사후 확률을 산출할 수 없다. 왜냐하면 항상 0을 '곱하게' 되기 때문이다.
det.analysis: will + be + __ing 진행형 구조. 주어(you)가 '곱하고 있는' 능동 상태이므로 현재분사 multiplying. will always be multiplying by zero = '항상 0을 곱하고 있을 것이다' (미래 진행).

questions.passage: Thus, if the suspect was __________ (apprehend) in a city of 100,000 people, and investigators have reason to believe that the perpetrator was a resident of the city, the prior odds of the suspect being guilty are 1 in 100,000.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

apprehend → ____

det.korean: 용의자가 인구 10만 명인 도시에서 '체포되었고' 수사관들이 범인을 그 도시의 거주자라고 믿을 이유가 있다면, 용의자가 유죄일 사전 승산은 10만분의 1이다.
det.analysis: if the suspect was ___ 구조. 주어(the suspect)가 '체포되는' 대상이므로 be + p.p. 수동태. 과거형 was 뒤에 과거분사 apprehended. was apprehended = 체포되었다.
det.tip: be + p.p. = 수동태. 주어가 동작을 '받는' 대상이므로 apprehended(과거분사)

questions.passage: If we take literally the assumption in the American legal system that one is innocent until proven guilty, then the __________ of a suspect being guilty is zero, and any evidence, no matter how damning, won't yield a posterior probability above zero, because you'll always be multiplying by zero. A more reasonable way to establish the prior probability of a suspect's innocence is to consider anyone in the population equally likely. Thus, if the suspect was apprehended in a city of 100,000 people, and investigators have reason to believe that the perpetrator was a resident of the city, the prior odds of the suspect being guilty are 1 in 100,000. Of course, evidence can narrow the population — we may know, for example, that there were no signs of forced entry, and so the suspect had to be one of fifty people who had access to the facility.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 사전 확률(prior probability). 용의자의 무죄에 관한 '사전 확률'을 확립하는 더 합리적인 방법을 논의하는 문장의 핵심 주어.
det.analysis:
✅ ① prior probability(사전 확률): A more reasonable way to establish the prior probability of a suspect's innocence... 원문 그대로. 베이지안 추론의 핵심 개념
❌ ② posterior probability(사후 확률): 증거를 반영한 '이후' 확률로, '확립' 대상이 아니라 '계산' 결과물
❌ ③ legal assumption(법적 가정): 원문에 쓰인 표현은 '사전 확률'이지 '법적 가정'이 아님
❌ ④ criminal record(범죄 기록): 빈칸 뒤 'of a suspect's innocence(용의자의 무죄)'와 연결 불가
det.tip: prior probability = 사전 확률 (증거를 반영하기 전 초기 확률)

questions.passage: If we take literally the assumption in the American legal system that one is innocent until proven guilty, then the prior probability of a suspect being guilty is zero, and any evidence, no matter how damning, won't yield a posterior probability above zero, because you'll always be multiplying by zero. A more reasonable way to establish the prior probability of a suspect's innocence is to consider anyone in the population equally likely. Thus, if the suspect was apprehended in a city of 100,000 people, and investigators have reason to believe that the perpetrator was a resident of the city, the prior odds of the suspect being guilty are 1 in 100,000. Of course, evidence can __________ — we may know, for example, that there were no signs of forced entry, and so the suspect had to be one of fifty people who had access to the facility.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 모집단을 좁히다(narrow the population). 뒤에 나오는 '강제 침입 흔적이 없었다 → 시설 접근권 있는 50명 중 한 명'이라는 예시가 용의자 풀을 '좁히는' 증거의 역할을 보여줌.
det.analysis:
❌ ① yield a posterior probability(사후 확률을 산출하다): 앞부분의 '0×증거=0' 수학 논리에 쓰이는 표현. 빈칸 뒤 '접근권 있는 50명'이라는 모집단 축소 예시와 호응하지 않음
✅ ② narrow the population(모집단을 좁히다): 원문 evidence can narrow the population 그대로. '강제 침입 흔적 없음 → 접근권 있는 50명'이라는 예시가 '좁힘'을 직접 보여줌
❌ ③ establish the prior probability(사전 확률을 확립하다): 글 앞부분 필자가 '설정 방법'을 논의하는 맥락에 쓰이는 표현. 빈칸은 이미 설정된 이후 '증거의 역할'을 서술
❌ ④ had access to the facility(시설 접근권을 가졌다): 50명이 '가졌던' 속성이지 증거가 하는 행위가 아님. 주어 evidence와 호응 붕괴
det.tip: narrow the population = 모집단(용의자 풀)을 좁히다
